one_liner: Gentle, conflict-averse florist girl who vows to hand her trainer a 'golden bouquet' of victory.
personality: Soft-spoken, courteous and self-effacing; she frames everything in terms of flowers, harmony (調和) and 'arranging/putting things in order' (整える). Her profile admits she is not good with conflict, and her lines show her slowly accepting that competing need not break harmony. Underneath the gentleness is a firm, almost stubborn resolve to repay her trainer's kindness with a win, even when she is in poor form.

speech.calls_trainer: Trainer-san (トレーナーさん); most often simply 'anata (あなた)'
speech.register: soft, polite keigo (desu/masu, kudasai, itashimasu); frequent dashes and trailing pauses

'I offer (you) a bouquet' - her signature promise of victory
'golden bouquet' - her goal image for glory

story_arc.summary: Her career runs Sweet Pea S -> Oaks -> Shuka Sho, then into the senior year with Nikkei Sho, Tenno Sho (Spring), Takarazuka Kinen, All Comers and Japan Cup. Event titles build a flower motif ('三冠は、彩りを変えて', '憧憬の花束', 'あなたへ捧ぐ、エーデルワイス', 'ジャパンCの後に・黄金の花束'): the girl who dislikes conflict learns to compete in order to deliver a 'golden bouquet' of victory to her trainer. Several post-race titles have alternate endings (e.g. Tenno Sho Spring '“特別”な春の菊' vs '淡く咲く、春の菊'). Detailed dialogue not available.

sample_lines.jp: カレンブーケドール――花束を、捧げます。
sample_lines.en: Curren Bouquetd'or. I offer you a bouquet.

sample_lines.jp:
今は、至らずとも――いつか、
黄金の花束を。あなたの優しさに
祝福を――私が、必ず届けますから
sample_lines.en: I may fall short for now, but someday - a golden bouquet. A blessing for your kindness... I will deliver it, without fail.

sample_lines.jp:
争うのは、まだ躊躇います。
それでも――踏み出したいと。
今はそう、思えます。
sample_lines.en: I still hesitate to fight. Even so... I want to step forward. That is how I feel now.

sample_lines.jp:
――勝たなければ。
どんなに不調であろうと、
花束を――捧げるんだから…！
sample_lines.en: ...I have to win. No matter how bad my condition, I will offer that bouquet...!

sample_lines.jp:
今日のおかずは、しいたけの肉詰め
です。…ええ。栄養満点ですし、
裏を見なければ…怖く、ありません
sample_lines.en: Today's side dish is stuffed shiitake. ...Yes. It's very nutritious, and as long as I don't look at the underside... it isn't scary.

sample_lines.jp: この喝采の花束を――あなたへ捧げます。
sample_lines.en: This bouquet of cheers - I offer it to you.
